sentences.text: Shri Ajay Vishwakarma, Advocate for the applicant/ accused.
Shri C.K.Mishra, G.A. for the respondent-State.
Records of the two courts below are received.
Heard on admission.
Admit.
Also heard on I.A.No.17923/2018, which is an application for taking additional documents on record.
For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
The documents are taken on record.
Also heard on I.A.No.17600/2018 filed by the applicant/accused for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted and sentence vide judgment dated 25/09/2018 passed by the Court of Addl. Sessions Judge, Special Court No.10, Electricity Act, Sagar in Criminal Appeal No.104/2016 confirming the judgment of conviction and sentence dated 7.1.2016 passed by JMFC, Sagar, District Sagar, in Cr. Case No.4749/2010, whereby the applicant has been convicted under section 16(1)(ka)(1) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to R.I. for 1 year and fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulation.

entities.text: Court of Addl. Sessions Judge, Special Court No.10, Electricity Act, Sagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submitted that the findings of the courts below are contrary to law.
Fine amount has been deposited.
Further, the applicant is in jail since 25.9.2018.

It is submitted that in this case prosecution has failed to prove the sanction order of prosecution,
hence, the whole proceedings are contrary to law.
Revision is of the year 2018 and its disposal will take time.
If the execution of jail sentence is not suspended, it would cause grave injustice to him.
Hence, learned counsel has prayed for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned G.A. opposed the application and prayed for rejection of the same.
Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, the said IA is allowed.

It is ordered that subject to deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited, the execution of jail sentence of applicant/accused Rajesh Kesharwani shall remain suspended and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.40,000/- (Rs.Forty Thousand only) with one surety in Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 November, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123998464/
1 the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial 2 CRR-4978-2018 court on 26/2/2019 and thereafter on all other such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the trial court in this regard.

sentences.text: In case, applicant is found absent on any date fixed by the trial court then trail court shall be free to issue and execute warrant of arrest without referring the matter to this Court, provided the Registry of this Court is kept informed.
List the case for final hearing as per its turn.
Certified copy as per rules.
